选择与表单

级联选择器 AsamCascader

从静态层级 options 选择节点。

使用场景 ​

从静态层级 options 选择节点。规范化节点保留 raw 和 children，以逐级菜单展示路径。ASAM 值模式返回节点值而非整条路径；需要原始模型时显式 native。

层级选择与自定义节点 ​

value/object 模式的 default 插槽收到 data、node 和对应规范化 option；native 模式原样传递原生 data、node。filterable 提供本地筛选。高级模式清空单选回到 null，native 模式保留原生清空值。

层级选择与自定义节点

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamCascader
			ref="control"
			v-bind="{ filterable: true, clearable: true, 'aria-label': '选择团队' }"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			@change="event = JSON.stringify($event)"
		>
			<template #default="{ data }"> {{ data.label }}节点 </template>
			<template #empty> 没有可选节点 </template>
		</AsamCascader>
		<AsamButton @click="control?.focus()"> 聚焦 </AsamButton>
		<output>值：{{ value }}；事件：{{ event }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamCascaderBasicExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCascader, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCascaderExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamCascaderExpose>();
const options = [
	{
		label: '团队',
		value: 'team',
		raw: {},
		children: [
			{ label: '设计', value: 'design', raw: {} },
			{ label: '开发', value: 'dev', raw: {} }
		]
	}
];
const value = ref<string | null>('design');
const event = ref('尚未更改');
</script>

<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	min-width: 0;
}

.row {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}

.density-grid {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr));
}

section {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
	min-width: 0;
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
</style>

多选与对象值 ​

multiple + valueMode=object 返回规范化节点数组。字符串存储只用于 value 模式，separator 不得与节点值冲突；所有节点值保持唯一。

多选与对象值

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamCascader
			v-model="objectValue"
			:options="options"
			v-bind="{ multiple: true, 'value-mode': 'object' }"
		/>
		<AsamCascader
			v-model="stringValue"
			:options="options"
			v-bind="{ multiple: true, 'multiple-value-mode': 'string', separator: '|' }"
		/>
		<output>对象：{{ objectValue }}；字符串：{{ stringValue }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

		]

原始节点字段与实例 ​

native 使用原始 options；props.emitPath=true 保存路径数组。getCheckedNodes 可读取已选节点；CascaderPanel 是独立常驻面板。

原始节点字段与实例

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamCascader
			ref="control"
			v-bind="{
				...{ 'value-mode': 'native' },
				...{
					options: nodes,
					props: { value: 'id', label: 'name', children: 'nodes', emitPath: true }
				}
			}"
			v-model="value"
		/>
		<AsamButton @click="inspect"> 读取节点 </AsamButton>
		<output>原始模型：{{ value }}；{{ inspected }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamCascaderNativeExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCascader, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCascaderExpose, AsamCascaderNativeProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamCascaderExpose>();
const value = ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>([]);
const nodes = [
	{
		id: 'team',
		name: '团队',
		nodes: [
			{ id: 'design', name: '设计' },
			{ id: 'dev', name: '开发' }
		]
	}
];
const inspected = ref('');
function inspect() {
	inspected.value = JSON.stringify(
		control.value?.getCheckedNodes(true)?.map((node) => node.value)
	);
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	min-width: 0;
}

.row {

	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}

.density-grid {

	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr));
}

section {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
	min-width: 0;
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
</style>

四档尺寸与上下文继承 ​

四个实例分别显式使用 large、big、default、small。下面省略 size 的实例随 ConfigProvider 响应切换；显式 size 覆盖祖先。面板本身没有 size 契约的入口不附加虚构尺寸属性。

四档尺寸与上下文继承

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="density-grid">
			<section data-density="large">
				<strong> large </strong>
				<AsamCascader size="large" :options="options" model-value="design" />
			</section>
			<section data-density="big">
				<strong> big </strong>
				<AsamCascader size="big" :options="options" model-value="design" />
			</section>
			<section data-density="default">
				<strong> default </strong>
				<AsamCascader size="default" :options="options" model-value="design" />
			</section>
			<section data-density="small">
				<strong> small </strong>
				<AsamCascader size="small" :options="options" model-value="design" />

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

ASAM 扩展包括四档密度及 value/object、array/string 模型策略。静态组件不处理 request/dictType；未知值保留回显，选项到达后重新解析。native 模式直接使用原始 options/data 和字段映射，禁止混入规范化字符串存储。树选择提供公开树实例方法，级联提供 focus/blur、节点读取和弹层操作；具体列表见 API。

模板中的 update:modelValue 与 change 按当前 valueMode、顶层或级联嵌套 multiple、multipleValueMode 推断：单值为节点值或 null，单对象为规范化节点或 null，多选为可写值数组或对象数组，字符串存储为 string（清空为 ''）。camelCase 与 kebab-case 属性遵循同一约束；单选父 ref 必须允许 null，不得用全模式 union 代替当前模式。native 保留原生声明的模型 union 和原生清空值，不能将路径/多选示例的初始数组视为所有返回形状。TS 示例中的窄类型声明可直接复制。

迁移旧挂载属性：popper-append-to-body 已淘汰，当前组件没有此属性。使用 teleported 控制级联弹层是否传送到组件外（默认 true）；false 将弹层留在原位置。appendTo / append-to 是支持它的弹层入口用于指定传送目标的属性，固定版本的 Cascader 未公开此属性，不能直接传入级联组件；它与 teleported 的开关语义不同。

native 模式的 TS 父模型使用 ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>，保留原生标量、路径、多选和空值声明；初始 [] 不应推断成 never[] 或仅路径数组。辅助 Checkbox 的模型使用其公开事件参数类型，Switch 输出传给布尔属性前作明确转换。

受控回写边界 ​

打开面板后，点击节点会产生候选值并发出 update:modelValue 和 change。固定 2.14.7 下，宿主忽略这次回写，或将候选转换回未发生变化的旧模型时，persistent=true 的面板可能继续显示候选值，getCheckedNodes 也可能返回该候选；关闭再打开不会自动回滚。此现象在原生级联、ASAM native、value 和 object 模式的对照中均已观察到，不能仅凭宿主模型未变就认为界面已经复位。

父级随后传入实际变化的 modelValue 时由原生组件重新同步显示和节点。persistent=false 关闭后销毁面板，公开 cascaderPanelRef 与 getCheckedNodes 遵循原生当前面板生命周期；ASAM 不再保存独立选择快照，也不补写原生标签删除或受控回滚算法。下方策略示例展示宿主模型、实际显示与公开节点的对照。

SSR 使用限制 ​

高级 lazy 的未知标量预填也受原生同步能力限制：叶节点在加载前尚不可解析时，加载后原生实例可能仍无标签和已选节点。ASAM 保留宿主值与未解析值装饰，不短暂重绑定 modelValue 来修补上游；需要显示已选叶节点时，应提供可解析的初始 options，或在节点加载后由宿主传入实际变化的模型。

固定 2.14.7 下，同一 SSR 服务进程连续渲染常驻级联弹层（persistent=true）时，可能出现节点 DOM ID 的 hydration mismatch；原生级联与 AsamCascader 均已实际复现。首次水合检查覆盖同一个新建 SSR 应用，不保证上述连续请求场景。模型值和标签显示正常也不代表水合没有警告。

API 阅读方式 ​

下方 Props、Events、Slots、Exposes 按当前实际公开类型与运行默认值生成。组合属性按分支生效，不能任意混搭值模式。标为“未知 / 未声明”的默认值不代表 false 或空值。所有示例的 TS 与 JS 版本和支持文件同源；复制多文件示例时保留目录及相对导入。

原生协议完整用法与 API ​

以下用法对应固定 2.14.7。Cascader 与 TreeSelect 的示例显式使用 value-mode="native"；其原生值、路径、字段映射和回调不能直接套到标准化模式。API 表保留原生默认值，ASAM 覆盖值与四档尺寸以下列约定为准。

If the options have a clear hierarchical structure, Cascader can be used to view and select them.

Basic usage ​

There are two ways to expand child option items.

Assigning the options attribute to an array of options renders a Cascader. The props.expandTrigger attribute defines how child options are expanded.

Basic usage

<template>
	<div class="m-4">
		<p>Child options expand when clicked (default)</p>
		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			@change="handleChange"
		/>
	</div>
	<div class="m-4">
		<p>Child options expand when hovered</p>
		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			:props="props"
			@change="handleChange"
		/>
	</div>
</template>

Disabled option ​

Disable an option by setting a disabled field in the option object.

In this example, the first item in options array has a disabled: true field, so it is disabled. By default, Cascader checks the disabled field in each option object; if you are using another field name to indicate whether an option is disabled, you can assign it in the props.disabled attribute (see the API table below for details). And of course, field name value, label and children can also be customized in the same way.

Display only the last level ​

The input can display only the last level instead of all levels.

The show-all-levels attribute defines if all levels are displayed. If it is false, only the last level is displayed.

Multiple Selection ​

Use value-mode="native" with props.multiple=true for native multiple selection. A named configuration object makes the configuration easy to reuse:

vue
<template>
	<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :props="props" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const props = { multiple: true };
</script>

When using multiple selection, all selected tags will display by default. You can set collapse-tags = true to fold selected tags. You can set max-collapse-tags to show max tags number, default 1. You can check them when mouse hover collapse text by using collapse-tags-tooltip attribute.

Multiple Selection

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="m-4">
		<p>Display all tags (default)</p>
		<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :options="options" :props="props" clearable />
	</div>
	<div class="m-4">
		<p>Collapse tags</p>
		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			:options="options"
			:props="props"
			collapse-tags
			clearable
		/>
	</div>
	<div class="m-4">
		<p>Collapse tags tooltip</p>
		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			:options="options"
			:props="props"
			collapse-tags
			collapse-tags-tooltip
			clearable
		/>
	</div>
	<div class="m-4">
		<p>Max Collapse Tags</p>
		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			:options="options"
			:props="props"
			collapse-tags
			collapse-tags-tooltip
			:max-collapse-tags="3"
			clearable
		/>
	</div>
</template>

Select any level of options ​

In single selection, only the leaf nodes can be checked, and in multiple selection, check parent nodes will lead to leaf nodes be checked eventually. When enable this feature, it can make parent and child nodes unlinked and you can select any level of options.

Set props.checkStrictly = true to make checked state of a node not affects its parent nodes and child nodes, and then you can select any level of options.

Dynamic loading ​

Dynamic load its child nodes when checked a node.

Set lazy = true to use dynamic loading, and you have to specify how to load the data source by lazyload. There are two parameters of lazyload,the first parameter node is the node currently clicked, and the resolve is a callback that indicate loading is finished which must invoke. To display the status of node more accurately, you can add a leaf field (can be modified by props.leaf) to indicate whether it is a leaf node. Otherwise, it will be inferred by if has any child nodes.

Dynamic loading

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :props="props" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
/*
MIT License

Copyright (c) 2020-PRESENT Element
Plus

Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy
of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal
in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights
to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell
copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is
furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:

The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all
copies or substantial portions of the Software.

THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE
AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
SOFTWARE.

*/
import { AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: cascader/dynamic-loading.vue

import type { AsamCascaderNativeConfig } from '@asam-ui/ui';

let id = 0;
const props: AsamCascaderNativeConfig = {
	lazy: true,
	lazyLoad(node, resolve) {
		const { level } = node;
		setTimeout(() => {
			const nodes = Array.from({ length: level + 1 }).map(() => ({
				value: ++id,
				label: `Option - ${id}`,
				leaf: level >= 2
			}));
			// Invoke `resolve` callback to return the child nodes data and indicate the loading is finished.
			resolve(nodes);
		}, 1000);
	}
};
</script>

Filterable ​

Search and select options with a keyword.

Adding filterable to AsamCascader enables filtering. In native mode, it matches nodes whose label or parent's label (according to show-all-levels) includes the input keyword. You can customize search logic with filter-method, which accepts node and keyword and returns a boolean indicating whether the node matches.

Custom option content ​

You can customize the content of cascader node.

You can customize the content of cascader node by scoped slot. You'll have access to node and data in the scope, standing for the Node object and node data of the current node respectively.

			<span v-if="!node.isLeaf"> ({{ data.children?.length ?? 0 }}) </span>
		</template>
	</AsamCascader>

Custom suggestion item ​

You can customize the filter suggestion item by suggestion-item slot. You'll have access to item in the scope, standing for the suggestion item.

	</AsamCascader>

Cascader panel ​

CascaderPanel is the core component of Cascader which has various of features such as single selection, multiple selection, dynamic loading and so on.

As with AsamCascader in native mode, AsamCascaderPanel accepts options and configures node behavior through props; see its API page for details.

独立面板示例见 AsamCascaderPanel。

Custom AsamCascaderTag ​

You can customize tags.

Insert customized tags into the tag slot of AsamCascader. collapse-tags, collapse-tags-tooltip, and max-collapse-tags do not apply to this custom rendering.

Custom Tag

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="m-4">
		<p>Using slots allows for more flexible control over the display.</p>
		<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :options="options" :props="props" clearable>
			<template #tag="{ data }">
				<AsamTag
					v-for="(item, index) in getTags(data)"
					:key="item"
					:color="index % 2 === 0 ? '#FFDE0A' : ''"
				>
					{{ item }}
				</AsamTag>
			</template>
		</AsamCascader>
		<p>Display top-level tags only</p>
		<AsamCascader value-mode="native" :options="options" :props="props" clearable>
			<template #tag="{ data }">
				<AsamTag v-for="item in getTopLevelTags(data)" :key="item">
					{{ item }}
				</AsamTag>
			</template>
		</AsamCascader>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>

OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
SOFTWARE.

*/
import { AsamCascader, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: cascader/custom-tag.vue

import type { AsamCascaderTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const props = { multiple: true };
const options = [
	{
		value: 1,
		label: 'Asia',
		children: [
			{
				value: 2,
				label: 'China',
				children: [
					{ value: 3, label: 'Beijing' },
					{ value: 4, label: 'Shanghai' },
					{ value: 5, label: 'Hangzhou' }
				]
			},
			{
				value: 6,
				label: 'Japan',
				children: [
					{ value: 7, label: 'Tokyo' },
					{ value: 8, label: 'Osaka' },
					{ value: 9, label: 'Kyoto' }
				]
			},
			{
				value: 10,
				label: 'Korea',
				children: [
					{ value: 11, label: 'Seoul' },
					{ value: 12, label: 'Busan' },
					{ value: 13, label: 'Taegu' }
				]
			}
		]
	},
	{
		value: 14,
		label: 'Europe',
		children: [
			{
				value: 15,
				label: 'France',
				children: [
					{ value: 16, label: 'Paris' },
					{ value: 17, label: 'Marseille' },
					{ value: 18, label: 'Lyon' }
				]
			},
			{
				value: 19,
				label: 'UK',
				children: [
					{ value: 20, label: 'London' },
					{ value: 21, label: 'Birmingham' },
					{ value: 22, label: 'Manchester' }
				]
			}
		]
	},
	{
		value: 23,
		label: 'North America',
		children: [
			{
				value: 24,
				label: 'US',
				children: [
					{ value: 25, label: 'New York' },
					{ value: 26, label: 'Los Angeles' },
					{ value: 27, label: 'Washington' }
				]
			},
			{
				value: 28,
				label: 'Canada',
				children: [
					{ value: 29, label: 'Toronto' },
					{ value: 30, label: 'Montreal' },
					{ value: 31, label: 'Ottawa' }
				]
			}
		]
	}
];
const getTags = (data: AsamCascaderTag[]) => {
	return data.map((item) => item.text);
};
const getTopLevelTags = (data: AsamCascaderTag[]) => {
	const set: Set<string> = new Set();
	for (const datum of data) {
		let parent = datum.node?.parent;
		while (parent && parent.level !== 1) {
			parent = parent.parent;
		}
		const label = parent?.data?.label;
		if (label) set.add(label);
	}
	return [...set];
};
</script>

const getTopLevelTags = (data) => {
	const set = new Set();
	for (const datum of data) {
		let parent = datum.node?.parent;
		while (parent && parent.level !== 1) {
			parent = parent.parent;
		}
		const label = parent?.data?.label;
		if (label) set.add(label);
	}
	return [...set];
};

Show Checked Strategy ​

Control how selected values are displayed in multiple selection mode.

In multiple selection mode, you can use show-checked-strategy to control how selected values are displayed. The default strategy is child, which shows all selected child nodes. The parent strategy only shows parent nodes when all their children are selected.

Show Checked Strategy

	<section class="controlled-boundary">
		<h3>常驻面板的受控回写边界</h3>
		<p>
			初始宿主值为3。选择节点2后，忽略回写或第一次转换回旧值3时，常驻面板可能保留候选2。
			关闭再打开不会自动回滚；随后将宿主改为4，可观察真实新值的同步。
		</p>
		<label>
			值模式
			<select v-model="mode" @change="resetLog">
				<option value="native">native</option>
				<option value="value">value</option>
				<option value="object">object</option>
			</select>
		</label>
		<label>
			宿主回写
			<select v-model="behavior" @change="resetLog">
				<option value="accept">接受候选值</option>
				<option value="reject">忽略回写</option>
				<option value="transform">非幂等转换：依次返回3、2、3</option>
			</select>
		</label>
		<div class="boundary-actions">
			<button type="button" @click="closePanel">关闭面板</button>
			<button type="button" @click="openPanel">重新打开</button>
			<button type="button" @click="readDisplay">读取显示与节点</button>
			<button type="button" @click="setParent">宿主改为4</button>
		</div>
		<AsamCascader
			v-if="mode === 'native'"
			ref="control"
			value-mode="native"
			:model-value="nativeModel"
			:options="boundaryOptions"
			:props="configuration"
			:persistent="true"
			@update:model-value="updateNative"
			@change="record('change', $event)"
		/>
		<AsamCascader
			v-else-if="mode === 'value'"
			ref="control"
			value-mode="value"
			:model-value="valueModel"
			:options="boundaryOptions"
			:props="configuration"
			:persistent="true"
			@update:model-value="updateValue"
			@change="record('change', $event)"
		/>
		<AsamCascader
			v-else
			ref="control"
			value-mode="object"
			:model-value="objectModel"
			:options="boundaryOptions"
			:props="configuration"
			:persistent="true"
			@update:model-value="updateObject"
			@change="record('change', $event)"
		/>
		<output class="boundary-model">宿主模型：{{ model }}</output>
		<output class="boundary-display">
			实际显示：{{ display.text }}；公开节点：{{ display.nodes }}；面板存在：{{
				display.panel
			}}

		<output class="boundary-events">模型事件：{{ events }}</output>
		<output class="boundary-transformations">转换调用：{{ transformations }}</output>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, nextTick, ref, unref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCascaderExpose, AsamCascaderNativeProps, AsamHierarchyOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const mode = ref<'native' | 'value' | 'object'>('native');
const behavior = ref<'accept' | 'reject' | 'transform'>('reject');
const configuration = { multiple: false, emitPath: false } as const;
const children = [
	{ value: 2, label: '节点2', raw: { id: 2 } },
	{ value: 3, label: '节点3', raw: { id: 3 } },
	{ value: 4, label: '节点4', raw: { id: 4 } }
];
const boundaryOptions = [{ value: 1, label: '根节点', raw: { id: 1 }, children }];
const nativeModel = ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>(3);
const valueModel = ref<AsamHierarchyOption['value'] | null>(3);
const objectModel = ref<AsamHierarchyOption | null>(children[1]);
const control = ref<AsamCascaderExpose>();
const transformations = ref(0);
const events = ref<{ name: string; value: unknown }[]>([]);
const display = ref<{ text: string; nodes: unknown[]; panel: boolean }>({
	text: '',
	nodes: [],
	panel: false
});
const model = computed(() =>
	mode.value === 'native'
		? nativeModel.value
		: mode.value === 'value'
			? valueModel.value
			: objectModel.value
);
async function readDisplay() {
	await nextTick();
	display.value = {
		text: unref(control.value?.presentText) ?? '',
		nodes: control.value?.getCheckedNodes(true)?.map((node) => node.value) ?? [],
		panel: !!control.value?.cascaderPanelRef
	};
}
function record(name: string, value: unknown) {
	events.value.push({ name, value });
	void readDisplay();
}
function transformedValue() {
	return ++transformations.value % 2 ? 3 : 2;
}
function updateNative(value: AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']) {
	record('update:modelValue', value);
	if (behavior.value !== 'reject')
		nativeModel.value = behavior.value === 'transform' ? transformedValue() : value;
}
function updateValue(value: AsamHierarchyOption['value'] | null) {
	record('update:modelValue', value);
	if (behavior.value !== 'reject')
		valueModel.value = behavior.value === 'transform' ? transformedValue() : value;
}
function updateObject(value: AsamHierarchyOption | null) {
	record('update:modelValue', value);
	if (behavior.value === 'reject') return;
	const transformed = behavior.value === 'transform' ? transformedValue() : undefined;
	objectModel.value =
		transformed === undefined
			? value
			: (children.find((option) => option.value === transformed) ?? null);
}
function resetLog() {
	events.value = [];
	transformations.value = 0;
	void readDisplay();
}
async function closePanel() {
	control.value?.togglePopperVisible(false);
	await readDisplay();
}
async function openPanel() {
	control.value?.togglePopperVisible(true);
	await readDisplay();
}
async function setParent() {
	nativeModel.value = 4;
	valueModel.value = 4;
	objectModel.value = children[2];
	await readDisplay();
}
</script>

示例前两个多选实例显式设置 persistent=false，并提供 native 路径预选值。关闭会销毁弹层面板，重新打开由原生组件按当前宿主值重建；parent 与 child 保留各自展示策略。关闭状态下标签、删除、清空以及 getCheckedNodes 的结果以 AsamCascader 当前公开实例为准，不保证销毁面板后仍有节点快照。宿主拒绝回写时的显示也遵循原生行为。

后面的受控回写实例固定 persistent=true，提供 native/value/object 模式和接受、忽略、非幂等转换三种宿主处理。宿主模型、实际显示、公开节点和模型事件分别展示；先选择节点2，可观察忽略或第一次转换回旧值3的边界，再关闭/重开并将宿主实际改为4观察同步。这些按钮只调用公开弹层方法或改变宿主模型，没有切换 persistent 或强制重建组件来回滚。

Click to Check Node ​

Only using multiple or checkStrictly attributes.

You can add checkOnClickNode to be able to click on the node in addition with the prefix icon.
Toggle the visibility of the prefix with showPrefix. 使用提示 Add checkOnClickLeaf to check only the leaf node (last children), enabled by default.

Custom Header & Footer ​

You can customize both the header and footer of the dropdown using slots.

Use slot to customize the content.

Custom Header & Footer

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="cascader-custom-header-footer">
		<div>
			<p>Custom header content</p>
			<AsamCascader
				value-mode="native"
				v-model="value"
				popper-class="cascader-custom-header"
				:options="options"
				:props="props"
				clearable
			>
				<template #header>
					<AsamCheckboxItem
						v-model="checkAll"
						:indeterminate="indeterminate"
						@change="handleCheckAll"
					>
						All
					</AsamCheckboxItem>
				</template>
			</AsamCascader>
		</div>
		<div>
			<p>Custom footer content</p>
			<AsamCascader
				value-mode="native"
				v-model="value"
				:options="options"
				:props="props"
				clearable
			>
				<template #footer>
					<AsamButton link size="small" @click="handleClear"> Clear </AsamButton>
				</template>
			</AsamCascader>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
/*
MIT License

Copyright (c) 2020-PRESENT Element
Plus

Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy
of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal
in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights
to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell
copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is
furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:

The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all
copies or substantial portions of the Software.

THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE
AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
SOFTWARE.

*/
import { AsamCascader, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: cascader/custom-header-footer.vue

import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

import type {
	AsamCascaderOption,
	AsamCascaderNativeProps,
	AsamCheckboxItemEmits
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
type CheckboxValueType = string | number | boolean;

const props = { multiple: true };
const checkAll = ref<AsamCheckboxItemEmits['update:modelValue'][0]>(false);
const indeterminate = ref(false);
const value = ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>([]);
const options = ref([
	{
		value: 'guide',
		label: 'Guide',
		children: [
			{
				value: 'disciplines',
				label: 'Disciplines',
				children: [
					{ value: 'consistency', label: 'Consistency' },
					{ value: 'feedback', label: 'Feedback' },
					{ value: 'efficiency', label: 'Efficiency' },
					{ value: 'controllability', label: 'Controllability' }
				]
			}
		]
	}
]);

const getAllValuePaths = computed(() => {
	const result: string[][] = [];
	const queue: { node: AsamCascaderOption; path: string[] }[] = options.value.map((node) => ({
		node,
		path: [node.value]
	}));

	while (queue.length > 0) {
		const { node, path } = queue.shift()!;
		if (node.children?.length) {
			node.children.forEach((child) => {
				queue.push({ node: child, path: [...path, child.value as string] });
			});
		} else {
			result.push(path);
		}
	}
	return result;
});

watch(value, (val) => {
	const count = Array.isArray(val) ? val.length : 0;
	if (count === 0) {
		checkAll.value = false;
		indeterminate.value = false;
	} else if (count === getAllValuePaths.value.length) {
		checkAll.value = true;
		indeterminate.value = false;
	} else {
		indeterminate.value = true;
	}
});

const handleCheckAll = (val: CheckboxValueType) => {
	indeterminate.value = false;
	value.value = val ? getAllValuePaths.value : [];
};

const handleClear = () => {
	value.value = [];
};
</script>

}

.cascader-custom-header .el-checkbox {

	height: unset;
}
</style>

Virtual Scroll ​

When dealing with large amounts of data, you can enable virtual scrolling to improve performance.

Set virtual-scroll to true to enable virtual scrolling. You can also customize the menu height with height and node height with item-size. Default height is 204px and default item size is 34px.

Virtual Scroll

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamCascader
		value-mode="native"
		v-model="value"
		:options="options"
		:filter-method="filterMethod"
		filterable
		virtual-scroll
		clearable
		placeholder="Select with large data"
	/>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
/*

Plus

OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
SOFTWARE.

*/
import { AsamCascader } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: cascader/virtual-scroll.vue

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamCascaderNode, AsamCascaderNativeProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface CascaderExampleOption {
	value: string;
	label: string;
	children?: CascaderExampleOption[];
}

const value = ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>([]);

const filterMethod = (node: AsamCascaderNode, keyword: string) => {
	return node.text.toLowerCase().includes(keyword.toLowerCase());
};

const generateOptions = (count: number): CascaderExampleOption[] => {
	return Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, index) => ({
		value: `option-${index}`,
		label: `Option ${index + 1}`,
		children: [
			{
				value: `child-${index}-1`,
				label: `Child ${index + 1}-1`,
				children: [
					{
						value: `grandchild-${index}-1-1`,
						label: `Grandchild ${index + 1}-1-1`
					},
					{
						value: `grandchild-${index}-1-2`,
						label: `Grandchild ${index + 1}-1-2`
					}
				]
			},
			{
				value: `child-${index}-2`,
				label: `Child ${index + 1}-2`
			}
		]
	}));
};

const options = ref<CascaderExampleOption[]>(generateOptions(20000));
</script>

Custom Suggestion Width ​

The width of the suggestion panel (when filtering) is calculated by default based on the maximum width of the matched options. If you customize the suggestion options through the suggestion-item slot, it is likely that the text displayed in the options is not equal to the value of label, resulting in calculation errors. In this case, you can use the fit-input-width attribute to fix its width. When the value is number, the width is a specific fixed pixel value.

使用提示

The fit-input-width attribute only controls the width of the suggestion panel during searching, it does not affect the default cascader panel.

Custom Suggestion Width

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center">
		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			placeholder="Default expanding panel"
			filterable
		/>

		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			placeholder="Fit input width"
			filterable
			fit-input-width
		/>

		<AsamCascader
			value-mode="native"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			placeholder="Fixed width (400px)"
			filterable
			:fit-input-width="400"
		>
			<template #suggestion-item="{ item }">
				<div>{{ item.text }} (Custom content that is very long)</div>
			</template>
		</AsamCascader>
	</div>
</template>

// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: cascader/fit-input-width.vue

const value = ref<AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']>();
const options = [
	{

		label: 'Guide',
		children: [

				]
			}
		]
	}
];
</script>

Cascader API ​

Cascader Attributes ​

Name Description Type Default
model-value / v-model binding value string / number /arraystring[] | number[] | any —
options data of the options, the key of value and label can be customize by CascaderProps. arrayAsamCascaderOption[] —
props configuration options, see the following CascaderProps table. objectCascaderProps —
size size of input enum'large' | 'default' | 'small' —
placeholder placeholder of input string —
disabled whether Cascader is disabled boolean —
clearable whether selected value can be cleared boolean —
clear-icon custom clear icon component string / objectComponent CircleClose
show-all-levels whether to display all levels of the selected value in the input boolean true
collapse-tags whether to collapse tags in multiple selection mode boolean —
collapse-tags-tooltip whether show all selected tags when mouse hover text of collapse-tags. To use this, collapse-tags must be true boolean false
max-collapse-tags-tooltip-height max height of collapse-tags tooltip. string / number —
separator option label separator string ' / '
filterable whether the options can be searched boolean —
filter-method customize search logic, the first parameter is node, the second is keyword, and need return a boolean value indicating whether it hits. Function(node: AsamCascaderNode, keyword: string) => boolean —
debounce debounce delay when typing filter keyword, in milliseconds number 300
before-filter hook function before filtering with the value to be filtered as its parameter. If false is returned or a Promise is returned and then is rejected, filtering will be aborted Function(value: string) => boolean —
popper-class custom class name for Cascader's dropdown and tags' tooltip string ''
popper-style custom style for Cascader's dropdown and tags' tooltip string / object —
teleported whether cascader popup is teleported boolean true
effect tooltip theme, built-in theme: dark / light enum'dark' | 'light' / string light
tag-type tag type enum'success' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'danger' info
tag-effect tag effect enum'light' | 'dark' | 'plain' light
validate-event whether to trigger form validation boolean true
max-collapse-tags The max tags number to be shown. To use this, collapse-tags must be true number 1
empty-values empty values of component, see config-provider array —
value-on-clear clear return value, see config-provider string / number / boolean / Function —
persistent when dropdown is inactive and persistent is false, dropdown will be destroyed boolean true
fallback-placements list of possible positions for Tooltip popper.js arrayPlacement[] —
placement position of dropdown enum'top' | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end' | 'left' | 'left-start' | 'left-end' | 'right' | 'right-start' | 'right-end' bottom-start
show-checked-strategy strategy for displaying checked nodes in multiple selection mode. Use parent when you want things tidy. Use child when every single item matters enum'parent' | 'child' child
virtual-scroll whether to enable virtual scrolling for large data boolean false
fit-input-width whether the width of the suggestion panel is the same as the input, if the value is number, then the width is fixed boolean / number false
item-size node height for virtual scrolling (px) number 34
height menu height for virtual scrolling (px) number 204

Cascader Events ​

Name Description Type
change triggers when the binding value changes Function(value: AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']) => void
expand-change triggers when expand option changes Function(value: AsamCascaderNativeProps['modelValue']) => void
blur triggers when Cascader blurs Function(event: FocusEvent) => void
focus triggers when Cascader focuses Function(event: FocusEvent) => void
clear triggers when the clear icon is clicked in a clearable Select Function() => void
visible-change triggers when the dropdown appears/disappears Function(value: boolean) => void
remove-tag triggers when remove tag in multiple selection mode Function(value: AsamCascaderNode['valueByOption']) => void

Cascader Slots ​

Name Description Type
default the custom content of cascader node, which are current Node object and node data respectively. object{ node: any, data: any }
empty content when there is no matched options. —
prefix content as Input prefix —
suggestion-item custom content for suggestion item when searching object{ item: AsamCascaderNode }
tag custom tags style object{ data: AsamCascaderTag[], deleteTag: (tag: AsamCascaderTag) => void }
header content at the top of the dropdown —
footer content at the bottom of the dropdown —

Cascader Exposes ​

Name Description Type
getCheckedNodes get an array of currently selected node,(leafOnly) whether only return the leaf checked nodes, default is false Function(leafOnly: boolean) => AsamCascaderNode[] | undefined
cascaderPanelRef cascader panel ref objectComputedRef<any>
togglePopperVisible toggle the visible type of popper Function(visible?: boolean) => void
contentRef cascader content ref objectComputedRef<any>
presentText selected content text objectComputedRef<string>
focus focus the input element Function() => void
blur blur the input element Function() => void

CascaderProps ​

Attribute Description Type Default
expandTrigger trigger mode of expanding options enum'click' | 'hover' click
multiple whether multiple selection is enabled boolean false
checkStrictly whether checked state of a node not affects its parent and child nodes boolean false
emitPath when checked nodes change, whether to emit an array of node's path, if false, only emit the value of node. boolean true
lazy whether to dynamic load child nodes, use with lazyload attribute boolean false
lazyLoad method for loading child nodes data, only works when lazy is true. The reject parameter is supported after version . Function(node: Node, resolve: Resolve, reject: () => void) => void —
value specify which key of node object is used as the node's value string value
label specify which key of node object is used as the node's label string label
children specify which key of node object is used as the node's children string children
disabled specify which key of node object is used as the node's disabled string disabled
leaf specify which key of node object is used as the node's leaf field string leaf
hoverThreshold hover threshold of expanding options number 500
checkOnClickNode whether to check or uncheck node when clicking on the node boolean false
checkOnClickLeaf whether to check or uncheck node when clicking on leaf node (last children). boolean true
showPrefix whether to show the radio or checkbox prefix boolean true

ASAM 模式与默认值 ​

默认 valueMode="value"，单选返回叶值或 TreeSelect 节点值，清空为 null；valueMode="object" 返回带 raw 的节点对象，多选清空为 []。0、false 与空字符串都是有效值。标准化 Cascader 固定 emitPath=false，需要完整路径使用 native。Cascader 顶层 multiple 显式值优先，未指定时读取 props.multiple。TreeSelect 默认 checkStrictly=true，显式 false 恢复父子联动；默认多选显示勾选框，显式 showCheckbox=false 可关闭。

标准化多选默认数组；value 模式可显式 multipleValueMode="string" 与 separator。分隔符不能为空，值不能包含分隔符，全树序列化 token 不得冲突。object 与 native 不接受字符串存储策略。未知选中值保留回填，已加载节点提供实际显示标签，不主动改写宿主旧对象。loader/options/valueMode 变更隔离迟到回调。

控件尺寸使用 large/big/default/small 四档及 ConfigProvider 的继承值。原生表中的 large/default/small 是底层尺寸，不能作为 ASAM 尺寸全集。基础组件只接收 options 或宿主 lazy 回调；Remote/Dict 的 provider、搜索及完整树获取属于对应数据入口。

标准化懒加载 ​

load/lazyLoad 返回 { value, label, raw, children?, leaf?, isLeaf? }，不是原生任意对象。Cascader 默认读取 leaf，TreeSelect 默认读取 isLeaf；自定义字段通过 props.leaf/props.isLeaf 映射，额外业务字段可来自 raw。内部实例 key 为带类型字符串，业务 v-model 保留原值；原生模式使用原始 key。每次 loader 的 resolve 仅接收一次，重复值、循环树或不合法字符串序列化会抛类型错误；reject 保留原生失败重试语义。内联 props 重建但 loader 本身未变时不会重复初始化动态节点。validateEvent=false 停止包装层的 change 验证，表单 disabled 继续由原生上下文继承。

三模式动态模型、回填与源切换

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="hierarchy-example">
		<p>依次展开“根节点”和子节点，加载两层；数字 0、false 与空字符串保留原类型。</p>
		<label
			>value<AsamCascader v-model="value" :props="{ lazy: true, lazyLoad: load }" clearable
		/></label>
		<label
			>object<AsamCascader
				v-model="objectValue"
				value-mode="object"
				:props="{ lazy: true, lazyLoad: load }"
				clearable
		/></label>
		<label
			>多选<AsamCascader
				v-model="multiple"
				multiple
				:props="{ lazy: true, lazyLoad: load }"
				clearable
		/></label>
		<label
			>字符串存储<AsamCascader
				v-model="tokens"
				multiple
				multiple-value-mode="string"
				:options="stringOptions"
		/></label>
		<div>
			<AsamButton @click="restore">回填数字 0</AsamButton
			><AsamButton @click="clear">清空</AsamButton
			><AsamButton @click="replace">切换源并丢弃迟到回调</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output
			>源 {{ version }}；value={{ JSON.stringify(value) }}；object={{
				JSON.stringify(objectValue)
			}}；multiple={{ JSON.stringify(multiple) }}；tokens={{ tokens }}</output
		>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCascader, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCascaderLazyLoad, AsamHierarchyOption, AsamValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const version = ref(1);
const value = ref<AsamValue | null>(null);
const objectValue = ref<AsamHierarchyOption | null>(null);
const multiple = ref<AsamValue[]>([]);
const tokens = ref('');
const stringOptions = [
	{ value: 1, label: '一', raw: {} },
	{ value: 2, label: '二', raw: {} }
];
const load = computed<AsamCascaderLazyLoad>(() => {
	const sourceVersion = version.value;
	return (node, resolve) => {
		setTimeout(() => {
			resolve(
				node.level === 0
					? [
							{
								value: 'root',
								label: '根节点 ' + sourceVersion,
								raw: { sourceVersion },
								leaf: false,
								isLeaf: false
							}
						]
					: [0, false, ''].map((value) => ({
							value,
							label:
								typeof value +
								':' +
								JSON.stringify(value) +
								' / 源' +
								sourceVersion,
							raw: { sourceVersion },
							leaf: true,
							isLeaf: true
						}))
			);
		}, 400);
	};
});
function restore() {
	value.value = 0;
	objectValue.value = { value: 0, label: '回填 0', raw: { restored: true } };
}
function clear() {
	value.value = null;
	objectValue.value = null;
	multiple.value = [];
	tokens.value = '';
}
function replace() {
	clear();
	version.value++;
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.hierarchy-example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}

label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
